description: `action.submit.fields`. Text entry (orders) goes into a slow window (`action.begin`, then `action.submit { window_id }`) or Compose; casts go as instant actions. If neither `left` nor `right` is present (or both are null), `text` is read instead: lines starting `l:`/`left:` go to the left hand, `r:`/`right:` to the right, other lines to the left. Remember the core caps `text` at 500 chars, so put long speech in the fields. The v0 keys `slow`, `sent_at`, `window` (and a `/slow` line) are refused.
